thread:
sarah_pm: Quick sync — proposing a new throughput window add-on (per-route reserved throughput for short windows) to address customers hitting soft spikes. Need to agree on pricing shape, launch criteria, and contract language. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
evan_product: Can you sketch the two pricing options? Fixed monthly vs credit-bucket? Which customers asked for this?
matt_revenue: Field asks from 2 mid-market + 1 enterprise pilot. My leaning: commit + softcap. Sell a small reserved window (e.g., 1-4 hours/day) with guaranteed throughput; rollover credits for unused windows.
liz_sales: Buyers want simple, predictable spend for marketing spikes. They hate per-request overage math. Rollover sounds attractive.
sarah_pm: Proposed shapes: (A) Monthly reserve SKU: throughput units for N hours/day, fixed price. (B) Credit bucket: buy Y credits, consumed during peaks, credits refill monthly, unused credits roll for 2 months.
evan_product: Runtime can enforce window caps; per-route isolation + preferring cached responses during windows will be needed. Ops implications?
ops_bob: Runtime can support per-tenant windows but per-route isolation requires route-level routing table changes and a priority queue. Need fallback policy: when reserved window exhausted, either fail fast or route to cheaper model variant. Estimate 3 infra sprints + 1 rollout sprint.
matt_revenue: Contract constraints: customers requested SLA during reserved windows. Legal will push back on hard uptime SLAs. Offer service credits instead of strict uptime.
legal_bot: Draft clause suggestion: During Purchased Throughput Windows, Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to meet reserved throughput. If Redwood fails to meet reserved throughput for a calendar month, customer may claim service credits defined as a percentage of the monthly reservation fee per measured shortfall, capped at a maximum percentage. Exclude force majeure and customer misconfig. Will draft exact numbers.
liz_sales: Customers want deterministic measurement windows and visibility. Add per-window telemetry and CSV export for audits.
evan_product: Console needs per-window consumed vs reserved, peak latency percentiles, and PDFable reports. Add feature flag for pilot customers.
sarah_pm: Launch criteria: 1) Runtime supports per-route reservation + fallback; 2) Console telemetry + CSV; 3) Legal-approved credit clause; 4) Pilot with 3 named customers and acceptance tests; 5) Engineering smoke tests for rollback.
matt_revenue: Pricing guardrails: start with high-margin pilot pricing (no discounts). After pilot, standard SKU with 10-15% intro discount.
ops_bob: Implementation constraint: fallback to cheaper model must be pluggable and safe for hallucination-sensitive routes. Need safety policy.
legal_bot: Also require whitelisted IPs and a customer POC for escalations in contract.
sarah_pm: Action items: @evan_product write one-pager comparing SKU vs credits + telemetry fields. @ops_bob estimate infra tickets & timeline. @legal_bot draft contract language with % caps. @liz_sales list pilot customers and confirm willingness for pilot terms. I'll sync Monday 9am. :calendar:
